why_ai: Commodity screen work that model-assisted pre-labelling and synthetic data steadily replace.
why_clarity: Defined labels on huge volumes of near-identical tasks, checked by consensus and gold sets.
why_digital: Data in, labels out, delivered by a remote workforce anywhere.

why_ai: Mining a structured, outcome-labelled annotation corpus is itself a machine learning task.
why_clarity: The questions asked, such as who is reliable, lack agreed answers the field can check.
why_digital: Annotation event logs in, analytics out, entirely on screens.

why_ai: Pre-labelling and automated workforce matching shrink the human share of delivery.
why_clarity: Task distribution and review flows are industrialised for established modalities.
why_digital: Online interfaces, remote workforce and a delivered dataset.

why_ai: Generating an interface from a task definition is the kind of software AI now builds.
why_clarity: Success is time from a new task requirement to a working interface.
why_digital: Software sold to in-house teams and used entirely on screens.

why_ai: Diagnosing bad-data complaints takes investigation, but the pipeline logs everything automation needs.
why_clarity: Each escalation needs working backwards to a cause with no standard method.
why_digital: Pipeline records and customer examples in, a diagnosis out, all digital.

why_ai: Capability tests are designable and can be generated and scored by models.
why_clarity: Whether someone can do the work is testable, but assessment design is currently ad hoc.
why_digital: Online screening and assessment of remote contributors.

why_ai: No ground truth exists and experts disagree, yet AI judges increasingly substitute for experts.
why_clarity: Correctness of an expert judgement is contested and consensus offers no reliable check.
why_digital: Reasoning traces and model outputs in, judged data out, by remote experts.

why_ai: Guideline ambiguity is detectable from disagreement patterns, which automation can surface and fix.
why_clarity: Guidelines are written once by feel and their effect on data is never measured.
why_digital: Written specifications for digital annotation tasks, revised on screens.

why_ai: Thin pools of scarce speakers and specialists make specific humans hard to replace.
why_clarity: Standard quality mechanisms fail with few contributors, so correctness is hard to check.
why_digital: Remote contributors annotate digital data in languages anywhere in the world.

why_ai: Per-task annotation work is interchangeable and is the first layer models absorb.
why_clarity: Tasks repeat at scale, but rejections on contested tasks give no clear verdict.
why_digital: Remote, per-task screen work paid online.

why_ai: Sourcing and routing contributors by capability signal is a matching problem software solves.
why_clarity: Matching contributors to tasks recurs per contract with measurable delivery speed.
why_digital: Online sourcing of a remote global workforce for digital delivery.
